name: @sofagent/audit
description: sofagent 提交时审计——扫描 git diff，检查 Agent 是否遵守工作纪律

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');for(const b of ['dist/cli-quick.js','dist/index.js']){try{fs.chmodSync(require('path').join(__dirname,b),0o755)}catch(e){}}const sync='../../tools/audit-baseline-sync.sh';if(fs.existsSync(sync)){try{cp.execSync('bash '+sync+' --quiet',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('[postbuild] 信任锚自动同步未成功，请手动执行: bash tools/audit-baseline-sync.sh')}}"
scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/rulesets',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('src/rulesets','dist/rulesets',{recursive:true});const n=fs.readdirSync('dist/rulesets').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).length;if(n===0){console.error('[copy-assets] ✗ dist/rulesets 为空——--ruleset/--list-rulesets 将失效');process.exit(1)}console.log('[copy-assets] ✓ rulesets '+n+' 个 json 就位')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && find dist -name '*.js.map' -delete && find dist -name '*.d.ts.map' -delete

author: KongFangXun
